_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::lubrication#2, and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry claimed 'h(x) -> 0 gives pressure NaN at the first time step (1/h^3 in the viscous term)'. On upstream lubrication_sb_2d.4C.yaml, replacing the height function by 0.0 gives pressure EXACTLY 0.0 — no NaN, no Inf, no zero pivot, no solver complaint, five clean Newton tables — because h enters multiplicatively (h^3 grad p) and never divides. h = 1e-14 behaves identically.
